fixtures.note: THE MANA CENSUS CREDITS ONLY THROUGH +144: sub_48340_48680 (:56911-19) reads the counted entity's +144 and nothing else - creature, castle, balloon, mana ball and house alike - and only the WORLD total is unconditional (:56919). So an AUTHORED castle, whose level-load mint sub_44D30 (:54974-55002) stamps +24 alone, is credited to NOBODY until its established tick echoes +144 = +24 (sub_46DB0 :56015). Vodor's keep (slot 680, +24 = 675, +144 = 0) holds 5000 and retail still censuses him at the intrinsic base 1000 where the port's invented +24 arm read 6000 - ledger 2026-08-18d.

THE BALLOON HAS NO SELF-KILL: sub_481D0_48510 (:56814-36) consumes the ch0 letter, stamps the killer into +38 (:56829) and RETURNS 2 - and nothing consumes that 2, because the walker (:52405) casts the class-3 handler to void(*)(Ent*) and discards it, unlike the castle twin sub_47EC0 whose 2 is the :56003 +70 = 6 park. THE CASTLE'S BALL ABSORPTION WALKS THE TICK-TOP BALL CHAIN: sub_46DB0's absorb block (:57023-32) iterates the chain head at dword_AE408_AE3F8() + 36466 - var_u32_36462[1], the same roster the rival's ball pick reads at :18878 - and RETURNS on the FIRST member matching +65 == 39 && +144 == castle +24 && sub_11950 overlap.
